notes: Derived from locked decision summary package
Pilot scope strictly limited to single quickchange

routing.reason: First pilot for bounded delegation requires careful review of safety constraints and fallback behaviors

feature_identity.name: First Real OR Pilot for Bounded Janus Delegation
feature_identity.scope: Single allowlisted quickchange task delegation with Codex-owned final authority

user_value.problem: Suitable low-risk Janus work should be delegable to a cheaper external worker path without losing local validation, diff review, or final acceptance control
user_value.benefit: Cost reduction for low-risk changes while maintaining quality gates and local control

actions: Accept or reject changes via explicit handoff

system_behavior.success: One tiny allowlisted quickchange returns a reviewable diff, changed-files list, validation evidence, and an explicit Codex-owned accept-or-reject handoff with no authority drift
system_behavior.failure: Any missing artifact, allowlist escape, touched-file-cap escape, delete or rename or move activity, or failed validation discards the delegated result and falls back to local Codex handling without claiming task completion

data_persistence.transient: Delegated results pending acceptance stored in temporary review queue
data_persistence.persistent: Accepted changes written to repo, rejection logs and audit trail retained

constraints.file_count_cap: Strict limit for tiny changes only

security_privacy.authority_boundary: Codex retains final accept/reject authority exclusively
security_privacy.no_drift: Explicit handoff only, no autonomous completion or release actions permitted
security_privacy.sandbox: External worker cannot access production routing, canonical tables, or Git actions

edge_cases.escape_attempts: Allowlist violation or touched-file-cap exceeded triggers immediate discard
edge_cases.validation_failure: Any validation error results in fallback to local handling
edge_cases.missing_artifacts: Incomplete return package (missing diff, changed-files list, or evidence) triggers discard
edge_cases.worker_failure: External worker timeout or disconnect safely aborts without partial writes

definition_of_done: One real bounded OR-assisted write task completed under Codex-owned review
Reviewable diff artifact generated and returned to Codex
Changed-files list explicitly enumerated in return package
Validation evidence attached to result package
Explicit accept-or-reject handoff presented to Codex operator
No authority drift detected in execution path
Fallback to local handling tested and verified for all failure modes

test_strategy.unit: Allowlist validator logic and file-cap enforcement
test_strategy.integration: End-to-end delegation and handoff flow with mock external worker
test_strategy.security: Escape attempt simulation and boundary validation

internal_complexity_breakdown.delegation_protocol: Medium - External worker contract and artifact exchange definition
internal_complexity_breakdown.safety_guards: Low - Allowlist and cap enforcement logic
internal_complexity_breakdown.handoff_mechanism: Low-Medium - Review state management and UI presentation
internal_complexity_breakdown.fallback_logic: Low - Local Codex path activation on validation failure
